# Verizon offers two months of free home internet plus holiday deals


[Español](https://www.verizon.com/about/news/es/internet-en-casa-dos-meses-por-nuestra-cuenta-fiestas)


Published Nov 05, 2026


E


Media contact:Eli Blumenthal


Published Nov 05, 2026


## At a glance


-


New Verizon Fios, Frontier Fiber and 5G Home customers receive two months of home internet service via bill credits.
-


The two months on us deal can be combined with premium plan offers so you can stack the savings.
-


New customers on select plans can also choose a Samsung 43" TV and Soundbar bundle on us or $200 toward gift cards for holiday shopping, stacked on top of the 2 months on us offer.


## What home internet deals are available right now?


Verizon is now covering[two months of home internet](https://vz.to/vz1140) for new Verizon Fios, Frontier and 5G Home internet customers, plus a Samsung 43" TV and Soundbar bundle or $200 toward gift cards for holiday shopping on select plans, in time for the weeks when a home network works hardest. And to add some extra peace of mind, our internet plans come with a multi-year price guarantee, so the base plan price you sign up for is the price you'll pay with no worries about surprise price hikes.


## What’s included in Verizon’s holiday home internet deal?


The offer combines a bill credit for two months of service with a multi-year price guarantee, plus on select premium plans, a choice of a Samsung 43" TV and Soundbar bundle or $200 toward gift cards for holiday shopping.

**Details**


**Who qualifies**

New customers on select Fios, Frontier Fiber and 5G Home internet plans


## Why the price guarantee matters as much as the two months on us


A free month or two gets attention, but the bigger number for most households is what the bill looks like a year from now. Many home internet promotions run for 12 months and then move to a higher regular rate. Verizon’s multi-year price guarantee keeps the base rate of the plan price the same for multiple years on eligible plans, for new and existing customers alike.


Streaming savings matter, too. Saving on top streaming services provides the whole family with the latest original shows, movies and sports.


## Is your home internet ready for a full house?


Guests rarely arrive with just one device. Between phones, tablets, laptops and the handheld game console that comes out after dinner, a household’s device count can climb fast over a long weekend.


A few checks before the doorbell starts ringing:


1.


**Run a speed test** at[Verizon speed test](https://www.verizon.com/speedtest/) in the rooms where people will gather, not just next to the router.


2.


**Count the devices.** Add your guests’ phones, tablets and laptops to your household total.


3.


**Walk the house.** Check Wi-Fi in guest rooms, the basement and the backyard, where signals tend to fade.


4.


**Set up a guest network** so visitors can connect without your main password.


## How to get two months of home internet on us


Ordering early gives you the best shot at being connected before guests arrive.


1.


**Check your address** at[verizon.com/home/internet](http://verizon.com/home/internet) to see which Verizon home internet service reaches your home: Fios, Frontier or 5G Home.


2.


**Pick an eligible plan.**
3.


**Turn on Auto Pay** to get the advertised price.


4.


**Schedule installation or setup, as needed.**


## Frequently asked questions


Does Verizon offer free months of home internet and how do I qualify?


Yes! The offer applies to new customers who install and maintain Fios 300 Mbps, Fios 500 Mbps, Fios 1 Gig, Fios 2 Gig, Fios 5G Gig, 5G Home, 5G Home Plus, 5G Home Ultimate service or any Frontier Fiber. Availability for each service varies. You will be charged for and are required to pay your first monthly bill; after that, a promotional credit will be applied via bill credit in 1 to 3 bill cycles after account qualification, depending on the service you select.


The promotional credit is based on the then-current monthly internet rate for the plan you sign up for (excludes equipment charges or charges for optional products/services). The promotional credit ends if home internet service is canceled. After the two-month service credit, standard monthly internet rates apply. One offer per eligible Verizon account, and the offer is subject to change.


What is the Verizon home internet price guarantee?


New and existing Verizon home internet customers on an eligible plan keep the same base monthly plan price for at least three years, depending on the plan.


Will my home internet bill go up after the first year?


In most cases, no. On eligible Verizon plans, the 3-year price guarantee keeps the base monthly plan price the same for three years.


Can I save by adding home internet to my Verizon phone plan?


Yes. With Auto Pay and a Verizon mobile phone plan, 5G Home starts at $35 a month and Frontier Fiber 500 Mbps starts at $30 a month.


Can I get discounts on popular streaming services with my home internet?


Home Internet customers on an eligible plan can save big on popular streaming services, and select premium plans can get 12 months of the Disney+, Hulu, & ESPN+ (With Ads) perk on us (then $12/mo after). Additional terms apply. *


Can I combine Verizon's two months on us offer with Verizon’s other offers?


Yes, you can! The Samsung 43" TV and Soundbar bundle or $200 toward gift cards for holiday shopping on select plans stacks on top, too. Customers choose one of these offers.


What is the Samsung 43" TV and Soundbar bundle and how do I get it?


New customers who sign up for select Fios, Frontier Fiber or 5G Home internet plans can get a Samsung 43" TV and Soundbar, on us.


Which gift cards can I get with Verizon home internet?


Instead of the Samsung 43" TV bundle, new customers on select plans can get $200 toward gift cards for holiday shopping. The exact amount varies by plan.
